subject.title: feat(onboard): recommendations store with once-semantics and self-naming bootstrap

question: Should OpenClaw persist one global recommendation offer and make acknowledgement permanently suppress future onboarding discovery until a later refresh feature exists?
rationale: This is a user-facing onboarding and durable-state policy choice, not a mechanical correction: it determines retention and repeat-run behavior for existing and new installations.

options.title: Approve the once-only contract
options.body: Accept the shared-state retention and rerun suppression model after reviewing final-head live evidence.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the state policy
options.body: Require an explicit reset/refresh lifecycle or a different owner scope before accepting persistent suppression of future discovery.

recommendation.title: Approve the once-only contract
recommendation.body: Accept the shared-state retention and rerun suppression model after reviewing final-head live evidence.
